snippet.title: Golden Self - Alpha Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮 Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4114430/Golden_Self/

Golden Self is a surreal, fast-paced pixel-art action roguelike about transformation and fear.

⚔️ Tight, responsive combat
💀 440+ unique items & abilities
🌀 Multiple bosses, endings

Each run offers new combinations, challenges, and discoveries.

🧩 Follow development:
🐦 X / Twitter: https://x.com/LightningOath_
🎥 YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@LightningOath

#IndieGame #Roguelike #PixelArt #ActionGame #GoldenSelf
